tagline: Run Google Search Console's declared streams and reverse-ETL actions.

global_flags.name: credential
global_flags.summary: Credential name to use for the Google Search Console request.

global_flags.name: limit
global_flags.summary: Maximum PM ETL records to emit; does not control Search Console rowLimit.

global_flags.name: max-bytes
global_flags.summary: Maximum direct-read response bytes; typed operations are capped at 16 MiB and each Google Search Console operation declares a lower limit.

global_flags.name: plan
global_flags.summary: Execute an approved reverse-ETL plan by id.

global_flags.name: preview
global_flags.summary: Preview a reverse-ETL write command without making a network mutation.

global_flags.name: approve
global_flags.summary: Approval token required to execute a reverse-ETL plan.

global_flags.name: confirm
global_flags.summary: Typed confirmation challenge for destructive reverse-ETL writes.

commands.summary: Run the official Mobile Friendly Test operation as a typed bounded direct read.

flags.name: request-screenshot
flags.summary: Request a screenshot in the provider response.

examples: pm google-search-console direct mobile-friendly-test run --credential gsc-prod --url https://example.com/page --request-screenshot false --json
commands.risk: low: bounded Search Console JSON read; fixed endpoint, closed request body schema, 1 MiB response cap, and redacted URL/screenshot-shaped fields

commands.summary: Run the official URL Inspection operation as a typed bounded direct read.

flags.name: site-url
flags.summary: Search Console site property URL or sc-domain property.

flags.name: language-code
flags.summary: Optional BCP-47 language code for localized inspection messages.

examples: pm google-search-console direct url-inspection inspect --credential gsc-prod --inspection-url https://example.com/page --site-url https://example.com/ --json
commands.risk: low: bounded Search Console JSON read; fixed endpoint, closed request body schema, 1 MiB response cap, and redacted URL-shaped fields

commands.summary: Read Search Analytics rows grouped by date and country.
examples: pm google-search-console search-analytics by-country --credential gsc-prod --config site_urls=https://example.com/ --json --limit 25

commands.summary: Read Search Analytics rows grouped by date.
examples: pm google-search-console search-analytics by-date --credential gsc-prod --config site_urls=https://example.com/ --json --limit 25

commands.summary: Read Search Analytics rows grouped by date and device.
examples: pm google-search-console search-analytics by-device --credential gsc-prod --config site_urls=https://example.com/ --json --limit 25

commands.summary: Read Search Analytics rows grouped by date and page.
examples: pm google-search-console search-analytics by-page --credential gsc-prod --config site_urls=https://example.com/ --json --limit 25

commands.summary: Read Search Analytics rows grouped by date and query.
examples: pm google-search-console search-analytics by-query --credential gsc-prod --config site_urls=https://example.com/ --json --limit 25

commands.summary: Plan deleting a sitemap URL from a Search Console site property through destructive reverse ETL.

flags.name: site-url
flags.summary: Search Console site property URL or sc-domain property.

examples: pm google-search-console sitemaps delete --credential gsc-prod --site-url https://example.com/ --feedpath https://example.com/sitemap.xml --preview --json
commands.risk: high: deletes a sitemap from a Search Console site property; requires reverse ETL plan, approval, and destructive confirmation
commands.approval: Use reverse ETL plan -> preview -> approval -> typed destructive confirmation -> execute. Missing provider records are idempotent for HTTP 404.

commands.summary: Read one sitemap entry for a Search Console site property.
examples: pm google-search-console sitemaps get --credential gsc-prod --config site_url=https://example.com/ --config feedpath=https://example.com/sitemap.xml --json

commands.summary: List sitemap entries for configured Search Console site properties.
examples: pm google-search-console sitemaps list --credential gsc-prod --config site_urls=https://example.com/ --json --limit 25

commands.summary: Plan submitting a sitemap URL for a Search Console site property.

flags.name: site-url
flags.summary: Search Console site property URL or sc-domain property.

examples: pm google-search-console sitemaps submit --credential gsc-prod --site-url https://example.com/ --feedpath https://example.com/sitemap.xml --preview --json
commands.risk: medium: submits a sitemap URL for a Search Console site property; requires reverse ETL plan and approval
commands.approval: Use reverse ETL plan -> preview -> approval -> execute. No raw HTTP body is accepted; the record must match writes.json.

commands.summary: Plan adding a Search Console site property through reverse ETL.

flags.name: site-url
flags.summary: Search Console site property URL or sc-domain property.

examples: pm google-search-console sites add --credential gsc-prod --site-url https://example.com/ --preview --json
commands.risk: medium: adds a site property to the authenticated Search Console account; requires reverse ETL plan and approval
commands.approval: Use reverse ETL plan -> preview -> approval -> execute. No raw HTTP body is accepted; the record must match writes.json.

commands.summary: Plan deleting a Search Console site property through destructive reverse ETL.

flags.name: site-url
flags.summary: Search Console site property URL or sc-domain property.

examples: pm google-search-console sites delete --credential gsc-prod --site-url https://example.com/ --preview --json
commands.risk: high: removes a site property from the authenticated Search Console account; requires reverse ETL plan, approval, and destructive confirmation
commands.approval: Use reverse ETL plan -> preview -> approval -> typed destructive confirmation -> execute. Missing provider records are idempotent for HTTP 404.

commands.summary: Read one verified Search Console site property as an ETL record.
examples: pm google-search-console sites get --credential gsc-prod --config site_url=https://example.com/ --json

commands.summary: List verified Search Console site properties as ETL records.
